GeoCoreServer._comment: XD01-382: the kernel's ROOT URL (no /api/geoassets suffix). Features, the global target ledger, the order-type registry, the permission contributor endpoint and the caller's identity are all reached over the kernel's REST API under it.

ServiceAuth._comment: XD01-299: client credentials of this host's GeoAssets.ServiceCaller service principal. Disabled (the default) registers no token provider: the kernel's machine-to-machine routes then answer 401, the vertical-registration check stays Degraded (/healthz still 200, /readyz 503) and ledger reservations answer 503.

VerticalRegistration._comment: XD01-382: retry schedule of the bootstrap registration (exponential backoff with jitter from InitialDelay to MaxDelay until it succeeds), then republished every RefreshInterval.

AzureAdCiam._comment: ClientId must be the kernel's API audience: this host forwards the caller's own token to the kernel's identity routes (/api/identity/me, /api/identity/organization-grants/me).

GeoAssets._comment: GeoAssets:Modules (XD01-382): this host's modules; 'neutral-operator' is the vertical itself.

Outbox._comment: Workflow integration-event transport (XD01-357): 'Kafka' (options in 'WorkflowKafka'), 'ServiceBus' (options in 'WorkflowServiceBus') or 'None'. With a broker, every order status change stages OrderStateChangedV1 (VerticalId neutral-operator) for the kernel's target-ledger consumer. With 'None' everything staged stays pending.
